Z / mm
Front barrel: object-side loading
G2 → tapered spacer → G1 → front retaining ring.
Middle barrel: load complete cells
Bench-assemble the G3/G4 and G5/G6 cells. From
the same front opening, insert G5/G6 first,
G3/G4 second, then the common retaining ring.
Rear barrel: image-side loading
G7 → long spacer → G8 cell → short spacer → G9 →
cup spacer → G10 → rear retaining ring.
Location & retention
G3/G4, G5/G6 and G8 are locally bonded within
their cells. Other groups use shoulders, spacers
and rings. The stop is integral with the teal
middle barrel and has a finite aperture land.
Preload path
Rear ring → G10 → spacer → G9 → spacer → G8
metal cell → spacer → G7 → rear-barrel shoulder.
G8 glass does not carry the full stack preload.
Version 5 removes thin bridges at the joints. Minimum uncut meridional wall distances: front 8.98, middle 8.10, rear about 8.47 mm. These
are geometric checks, not stress qualification.
Nominal demo geometry. No new aperture/ray check. Ports, threads, tolerances and preload require CAD/engineering review.
